name: Neraka Yang Terhijab
overview: Adda is a university student struggling to get on with her life after her scholarship money is misused by her own father, Malik. With the family's financial situation worsening, Adda had to work hard to meet their needs. However, the harder she tries, the more she plunges into the darker side of life. At first she refused, but the pressure of life finally made her choose to live a double life as an upper-class escort for money. At the same time, Adda is also caught in the conflict between two half-brothers, Annas and Zakwan. When Zakwan uses himself to destroy his own brother, Annas begins to see her as more than just a woman to be used. In a world filled with secrets and lies, their journey ends up being a battle about dignity, power and the price of redemption.
